test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:

My brother built this house in 2005.

options.text: This house was built by my brother in 2005.
This house is built by my brother in 2005.
This house built by my brother in 2005.
This house was being built by my brother in 2005.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Identify the Tense:** The active sentence "built" is in the **Simple Past Tense**.
 
• **Passive Structure for Simple Past:** The formula is **Object + was/were + Past Participle (V3) + by + Subject**.
 
• **Step 1:** Identify the object "this house" and make it the new subject. Since "house" is singular, we use **"was."**
 
• **Step 2:** Use the third form (Past Participle) of the verb "build," which is **"built."**
 
• **Step 3:** Add the agent "by my brother" and the time reference "in 2005."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"This house was built by my brother in 2005."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "is built" – This is the Present Simple Passive. It is incorrect because the action happened in the past (2005).
 
• **Option 3:** "built" – This lacks the auxiliary verb "was," making it grammatically incomplete as a passive sentence.
 
• **Option 4:** "was being built" – This is the Past Continuous Passive. It suggests the building was an ongoing process at that specific time, rather than a completed action.
